articles.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion
articles.snippet: The Binance hack has revived debates about whether decentralization is the digital asset industry’s greatest security advantage or its biggest point of weakness.

articles.title: What is EIP-7702? The Ethereum Upgrade Behind the $6.4B Binance Hack
articles.snippet: EIP-7702 lets ordinary Ethereum wallets run smart contract code, enabling batched and sponsored transactions. Here's how it works.
